AGENDA
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE

  DECEMBER 5, 2023
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF ASSEMBLY
BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS COUNCIL MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE LOCATION WITHOUT
LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING: YOU MAY ATTEND THE
MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, OR JOIN THE ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING:
(669)  900-6833  OR  USING  THE  ZOOM  APP  WITH  THE  FOLLOWING  LINK:

84862304700; PASSCODE: 845338. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED THROUGH ZOOM, FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR
CHARTER CHANNEL 3, OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-
393.

  REGULAR MEETING
  6:00 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Ana Valencia, Chair
  Margarita L. Rios, Vice Chair
  Tony Ayala, Board Member
  Jennifer Perez, Board Member
  Rick Ramirez, Board Member
 Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the Agency on any matter listed on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction
 subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the Norwalk Municipal Code. If you wish to address the Agency, please complete
 the card that is provided at the rear entrance to Council Chambers and hand the card to the Sergeant at Arms. The Agency will hear public comment
 on items listed on the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote. The Agency will hear public comment on matters not listed on the
 agenda during the Oral Communications period.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or
 special circumstances exist. The Agency may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration at a future Agency meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Agency:
   Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
   Comments should be directed to the Agency as a whole and not directed to individual Agency Members.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services
 offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City
 Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate
 alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the
 City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Agency regarding any item on this agenda after it has been posted will also be
 made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk’s Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard during regular business
 hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday; telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact
 the City Clerk via e-mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.
  CALL TO ORDER

Chair Valencia

 ROLL CALL

Theresa Devoy, CMC
Secretary

  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  NORWALK, CALIFORNIA
  NOVEMBER 7, 2023

Chair Valencia called the hybrid meeting to order at 6:09 p.m. in the Council Chambers,
Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California, and via
videoconference pursuant to Assembly Bill 361. Responding to roll call were Board
Members Ayala, Perez, and Ramirez, Vice Chair Rios, and Chair Valencia. Also
present were Jesus M. Gomez, Executive Director; Arnold M. Alvarez-Glasman, Agency
Counsel; and Theresa Devoy, Secretary.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one
motion and roll call vote. Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and
considered separately by the Agency. Board Member Ramirez moved and Vice Chair
Rios seconded to approve the consent calendar as recommended. MOTION CARRIED
BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Board Members Ayala, Perez, and Ramirez, Vice Chair Rios, and
  Chair Valencia
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

MEETING MINUTES

The Agency approved the minutes of the regular meeting of October 3, 2023.  1305-03

WARRANTS

The Agency approved the warrant register for the period of September 26, 2023 through
October 30, 2023, in the total amount of $117,625.00.  1310-01

EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT

None.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

There were no persons wishing to address the Agency.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment Agency
November 7, 2023

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business to come before the Agency, the meeting was adjourned
at 6:10 p.m.
